project.name: Evi
project.user: Analysts comparing financial figures across telecom statements
project.failure: A transcribed value can be correct while its reporting period, monetary unit or parent-attribution scope is wrong
project.mechanism: Derive applicable table context, check the model claim, issue a policy-versioned source-support certificate and gate any field revision

evidence_levels.implementation: Present in inspected source code; does not by itself establish runtime success
evidence_levels.controlled_test: Isolated test or simulated provider/fault; does not establish a real provider call
evidence_levels.recorded_local: Saved execution on the local machine
evidence_levels.recorded_public: Saved execution through the hosted public application
evidence_levels.provisional_measurement: Measured against builder-drafted, source-reviewed references pending independent review
evidence_levels.pending: Not established by the linked records

claims.claim: Evidence existence is insufficient: row, column, interval and unit context must apply to the selected value cell
limits: Documented layouts only
Not issuer accounting truth

claims.claim: Source-support decisions can be recomputed from source bytes and the stored Docling artifact under their issuing policy
limits: Not a signature
Re-verification does not freshly parse the PDF or call an AI provider

claims.claim: Field proposals cannot change source/target identity, invent evidence or regress supported fields; outcomes create immutable lineage and receipts
limits: A valid outcome may be no accepted changes

claims.claim: A new SERV extraction completed through the public website and reload recovered the same job
limits: Not a fresh hosted Docling parse
Live processing depends on available allowance and worker readiness

claims.claim: Eleven actual historical Reppo evaluations exist; evaluated-version lineage is inspectable
limits: Historical packet v1 contained only candidate-cited cells
A 100/100 evaluation is not measured extraction accuracy
No incremental Reppo benefit established

claims.claim: Manifest-derived replay checks required policy, target/version coverage, receipts, source identities and reproduced scores without paid calls or summary writes
limits: The 618-certificate historical audit is a separate coverage claim

claims.claim: Atomic pre-request reservations enforce finite owner-configured totals; unknown submissions are not automatically repeated
limits: Configured allowance is distinct from current remaining quota
No universal exactly-once provider guarantee

claims.claim: Session-owned PDF upload, preview and one-page processing are implemented; local fresh parsing and partial hosted acceptance are recorded
limits: First saved public attempt failed during Docling parsing before SERV
Local test source was already development material
No automatic sector/language classification claim

measurements.reference_provenance: Builder-drafted, source-reviewed, provisional; not independent human gold

experiment_b.design: Post-hoc development experiment; same saved baselines and Reppo evaluations
limits: All improvements came from one revision branch
Not unseen-holdout validation

metric_definitions.reference_match: All frozen fields agree; start date derives from the model's own end date/duration independently of checker verdict; matching nulls count as faithful absence
metric_definitions.complete_interval: Known start and end matching reference; distinct from matching null dates

limits: Targets and trials are correlated
AT&T pages were inspected during rule design
No independently validated general accuracy estimate

source_explorer.count_definition: Reported observations retaining repeated comparative disclosures; not unique economic facts, processed PDF facts or detected errors

commercial_hypothesis.buyer: Financial research or data teams that need auditable PDF-derived figures
limits: No measured willingness to pay, customer adoption or time-saving estimate
